visual_action: Joe Biden sits at a wooden table and speaks to the camera while holding a white coffee mug. The mug has a blue graphic of his face wearing aviator sunglasses. An unseen person pours liquid from a metal carafe into the mug. The video then zooms in on the mug, and the sunglasses on the graphic digitally turn bright red and glow.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Visible on screen speaking for the majority of the video.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Joe Biden says, "I'll ask you nicely. But he won't," implying his political opponent.

on_screen_text.text: I think you should buy this mug.

spoken_summary: Joe Biden suggests that the viewer should buy a mug he is holding. He says, "I'll ask you nicely. But he won't," contrasting his approach with an implied other person.
audio_music: A light, gentle instrumental track plays at the beginning. It is abruptly interrupted by a loud, ominous, and dramatic synthesizer chord when the sunglasses on the mug's graphic glow red.
editing_pacing: The video starts with a medium shot of Joe Biden, then slowly zooms in to a close-up on the mug he is holding.
manipulation_or_satire: The aviator sunglasses on the graphic of Joe Biden's face on the mug are digitally animated to glow bright red, resembling laser eyes.
central_claim: Joe Biden is a reasonable and powerful leader, unlike his opponent who is implied to be aggressive and demanding.
intended_effect: To encourage viewers to buy campaign merchandise by portraying Joe Biden as both personable and powerful through the 'Dark Brandon' meme, while simultaneously casting his opponent in a negative light.
